kw_max_gewogen_per_maand.location: dictum para 149, table 2 (Vastgestelde tarieven), row 'EHS tarieven 2026', kW max gewogen per maand

notes: Applies to a consumer connected directly to TenneT's grid at this voltage level only; a DSO customer already pays TenneT's costs inside the DSO tariff, so never add this tariff to a DSO bill.

The vastrecht is set per connection per year (TenneT's own tariff sheet: 'Vastrecht per jaar'); it is stored as per_month = annual / 12 at full precision. The engine prorates a per_month charge by the hours covered in each month over that month's hours, so a full year bills the annual figure.

kW gecontracteerd is billed on the contracted transport capacity for take-off for the calendar year (art. 3.9 lid 7); this app takes it from the connection (point-of-connection Link) capacity, and without one the charge is not established, never billed on a measured peak.

kW max gewogen per maand is not modelled: each quarter-hour value is multiplied by a weighting factor by month, hour and working day or weekend (Tarievencode elektriciteit 2026 art. 3.9 lid 5, annex 5) and the highest weighted value counts; the bill names it and has no total.
The low-usage product (at most 600 operating hours a year: 0.5 x contracted kW and a weekly weighted peak, art. 3.9 lid 2) is not modelled.
Amounts exclude VAT and energy tax, and exclude system-service and connection-service charges.

Valid 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, in euro (EUR) at 2026 price level. A project modelled outside 2026 gets the engine's existing warning commercial.tariff_out_of_validity; nothing is refused or rescaled.
